channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump and Xi to meet in Beijing: The key issues shaping the China summit
item.description: Trump and Xi meet as trade, Taiwan and the Iran war dominate a high-stakes US-China summit.

item.title: Bahrain-led UN resolution on Strait of Hormuz gains support of 112 nations
item.description: The resolution calls for free navigation through the strait and an end to Iranian attacks on its Gulf neighbours.

item.title: Putin hails Russia’s test launch of ‘most powerful missile in the world’
item.description: Russian leader says the nuclear-capable Sarmat missile will enter combat service at the end of the year.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump travels to China as conflict with Tehran looms large
item.description: Israeli attacks on Lebanon have killed 2,883 people and injured 8,787 since March 2, Lebanon's Health Ministry says.

item.title: Trump says he does not need Xi’s help on Iran war as he heads to China
item.description: Trump gives conflicting messages on prominence of Iran war in upcoming talks with China's Xi.

item.title: Trump backs Pakistan as Iran mediator after criticism from Lindsey Graham
item.description: US president lauds Islamabad, but his Republican ally says he does not trust Pakistan to facilitate Iran diplomacy.

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.

item.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
item.description: The most comprehensive report of its kind details harrowing cases of sexual attacks which it says were systematic.

item.title: Dali ship operator charged over deadly Baltimore bridge collapse
item.description: Six construction workers were killed and several vehicles plunged into the river after the cargo ship crashed into the bridge.

item.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
item.description: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has severely disrupted global supplies of energy and petrochemicals.
